product_concept: A robust-but-simple US 1099 tax & get-paid toolkit for a specific freelancer sub-niche (e.g. content creators or rideshare/independent contractors): a spreadsheet that gets the SE-tax + quarterly-estimate math right, plus an invoice template and a short setup guide.

transformation.from_state: From 'no idea what to set aside and formulas that break'
transformation.to_state: 'know my quarterly number, invoices out, expenses categorised for Schedule C, no tax-season panic'
transformation.promise: Know exactly what to set aside every quarter and get paid on time — without an accountant or a broken spreadsheet.
transformation.core_problem: No withholding, quarterly estimated taxes and Schedule C categories are confusing; generic templates break or don't match the tax regime.
transformation.desired_outcome: Invoice, track income/expenses, and know what to set aside for taxes without panic at year-end.

promise: Know exactly what to set aside every quarter and get paid on time — without an accountant or a broken spreadsheet.
price_rationale: Observed: dedicated US trackers sell at $9-25; RunTheCalc does 2.2k sales at ~$17. $15-25 sits in the proven band and above $1 generics without needing subscription justification.
